name: Boston College
character: The main campus sits atop a hill overlooking the Chestnut Hill Reservoir and features over 120 collegiate Gothic buildings with towers reaching into the sky.

landmarks.name: St. Ignatius Gate
landmarks.quote: The campus is accessible via the Boston College station, situated at St. Ignatius Gate.
landmarks.look: A campus gate next to a transit station.

landmarks.name: St. Mary's Hall
landmarks.quote: The chapel for the university is located in St. Mary's Hall, the Jesuit residential facility.
landmarks.look: A residential hall containing a university chapel.

landmarks.name: Gonzaga Hall
landmarks.quote: St. Joseph's Chapel in the Basement of Gonzaga Hall on Upper Campus
landmarks.look: A campus hall with a chapel in its basement.

landmarks.name: Cushing Hall
landmarks.quote: and St. Catherine of Sienna Chapel in Cushing Hall.
